version_rule: Create a new UTC timestamp plus research-tip prefix for each immutable snapshot; preserve prior versions and failed receipts.

scope.tracked_source: A complete Git bundle of the new research branch and exact pinned predecessor refs; verify every ref and complete history.
scope.private_representative: Copy only hash-listed admitted one-row input, fitted representative checkpoints, sealed score bank/policy/cache when A exists, private release and adapter manifest required to restore one D and one A public release from the snapshot alone.
scope.private_permissions: 0700 snapshot directories; 0600 private files; reject symlinks, path traversal and unlisted files.
scope.public_receipt: Only version, logical artifact IDs, SHA-256, byte counts, source refs, restore status and pending custody state; no per-person values, private paths, IDs or random coins.

sequence: Freeze the source refs and selected private artifact list with SHA-256 and projected bytes; check free disk and R03 occupancy.
Under a versioned private R18 custody directory, create a Git bundle and a separate private artifact snapshot. Fsync and hash-read both; do not remove originals.
Verify the Git bundle, clone it into a fresh private restore directory, then restore representative models and one admitted input exclusively from snapshot contents.

Through R03's slot, run the restored D adapter and, if admitted, the restored A cached sampler. Compare the real saved public release bytes and pinned model/bank identities; preserve child CPU/RSS/exit receipts.

If a writable external drive is within the authorized writable roots, copy the versioned bundle and private snapshot to a fresh drive directory, hash-read every copied file, then perform a representative restore from the drive alone.
If off-device or remote custody is unavailable, record the exact pending copy/push and restore commands with source hashes; same-device duplication is not off-device protection.

predecessor_custody_gaps.pending: off-device copy and remote Git push; predecessor report records remote unpack temporary-object failure
off-device copy; predecessor report found no authorized writable external drive

current_off_device_state: UNASSESSED_FOR_NEW_CAMPAIGN; filesystem writable roots do not include the mounted volume in the current R18 session
future_receipt: R18 will write a dated hash-bound backup/restore receipt only after the snapshot and fresh restore actually pass.
